notes.note: The Campaign overview body is a shell: it reads no dialer_campaigns rows, so there is no count and no table, and the scope line under the title is fixed text. campaignScope(staff) is deliberately not called here because it refuses an Assistant with no assigned preacher, which this surface admits; the campaign-listing story must either widen the Assistant's scope or show a count only for a scoped Assistant.

/campaigns/assignments renders an actionable empty state but reads no queue: dialer_assignments is untouched, so the page cannot say how many calls are waiting. The caller's queue read belongs to Story 2.1 and has to land before the surface can show anything beyond the empty state.

The Campaign sub-nav links to /campaigns/callers, /campaigns/reports and /campaigns/new, none of which exist yet - they are Story 1.4 and later - and a Volunteer has no phone route into Campaign at all until the chrome layer lands the header pill, the bottom-nav entry and the Campaign menu. Until then the caller surface is reachable only by URL.

notes.reason: Story 1.9's overview reads listCampaignsWithProgress, which calls campaignScope; the shell has real rows and counts now
